seoTitle: Olathe Public Schools Calendar 2027–28: Key Dates
seoDescription: Olathe Public Schools begins Aug. 12, 2027, for grades K–5, 6 and 9. See 2027–28 start dates, breaks, half days, last days, school hours and official PDFs.
heroSummary: Olathe Public Schools starts the 2027–28 school year with a half day for grades K–5, 6 and 9 on Thursday, Aug. 12. All K–12 students attend a full day Aug. 13, and Early Childhood starts Aug. 16. Fall Break is Nov. 22–26, Winter Break is Dec. 20–31, Spring Break is March 13–17, and grades K–11 finish with a half day May 23.
heroSourceLine: Based on the official OPS 2027–28 district calendar, revised February 5, 2026
heroVerificationSourceText: Reviewed against the current OPS district calendar
heroVerificationComparisonText: The Spanish edition was also reviewed
calendarNotes: OPS again uses a three-step opening: grades K–5, 6 and 9 attend a morning half day August 12; all K–12 grades attend a full day August 13; Early Childhood begins August 16. The PDF lists 170 reporting-period days across four quarters. Conference windows run October 11–13 and February 14–16, but buildings provide appointment times; October 13 and February 16 are half days, while October 14 and February 17 are no-student conference days. Winter Break ends December 31, but January 3–4 are professional days, so students resume January 5. March 20 and April 21 are printed both as professional days and possible inclement-weather dates, and their status can change if OPS activates them. Grade 12 ends May 18, Early Childhood ends May 22, and grades K–11 finish May 23. OPS linked a Spanish translation for this year but no 2027–28 Elementary Specials PDF at the August 18, 2026 review.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Olathe Public Schools start in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades K–5, 6 and 9 attend a half day Thursday, August 12, 2027. All K–12 students attend a full day on August 13, and Early Childhood starts August 16.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Olathe students return after Winter Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 20–31, 2027. January 3–4 are professional days with no students, so students return Wednesday, January 5, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When are the 2027–28 Olathe conference half days?
calendarFaqs.a: Wednesday, October 13, 2027, and Wednesday, February 16, 2028, are half days for grades K–12 with no Early Childhood. The following Thursdays are conference days with no students.

calendarFaqs.q: What are the possible Olathe weather make-up dates in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: March 20 and April 21, 2028, are scheduled professional days that OPS may use to recover time lost to inclement weather. Check OPS announcements before relying on either date as a day off.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Olathe Public Schools in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Seniors finish May 18, Early Childhood finishes May 22, and grades K–11 finish with a morning half day Tuesday, May 23, 2028. Grade 12 does not attend May 23.

calendarFaqs.q: When are Olathe high school finals in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Finals use regular high school hours December 15 and May 19. They use the 7:40–10:55 a.m. schedule December 16–17 and May 22–23.

calendarFaqs.q: How many days are in the Olathe 2027–28 reporting periods?
calendarFaqs.a: The official PDF lists 40, 42, 43 and 45 days, totaling 170 reporting-period days.

calendarFaqs.q: Does OPS publish a Spanish 2027–28 district calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The official Spanish PDF is linked in Downloads and follows the same dates, reporting periods and school hours as the English district calendar.
